coverage: Major AI, bioinformatics, biomedical imaging and omics conferences, plus selected advanced training. Primarily late 2026–2027; next-edition watchlists are included. Curated coverage, not an exhaustive worldwide directory.

updatePolicy.note: Daily official-source review is scheduled, beginning 10 October 2026. The dashboard checks the published catalog every 15 minutes. Individual source verification dates appear on each entry.
